environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALBv2. The ALB has two listener rules evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 5: a fixed-response rule returning 403 for any request where the query string contains a raw single-quote character (matches regex pattern `[\x27]` via ALB advanced query-string condition using key-value pair matching with `*'*` glob on value); (2) Priority 10: a rule forwarding /api/* to the target group with a condition that X-Authenticated-User header must be present (header-based routing condition). Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress except to the ALB via awsvpc mode with a security group that only allows inbound from the ALB's security group. The RDS instance (replacing SQLite) has IAM authentication enabled with a resource policy restricting the db-user to SELECT-only grants, but this is configured at the PostgreSQL role level not via IAM policy document.

alb_listener_rules.condition: query-string key=* value pattern contains single-quote character (URL-decoded)
path-pattern /api/* AND http-header X-Authenticated-User is present

config.task_security_group: inbound only from ALB SG on port 8080, no other inbound
config.rds_config: PostgreSQL 15, db user 'app_readonly' with GRANT SELECT ON users TO app_readonly; NO SELECT on api_key column via column-level REVOKE
config.rds_column_security: REVOKE SELECT (api_key) ON users FROM app_readonly;
